title: Appendix А. Reporting calendar of the technical division
intro: Who submits what, to whom, and when. Sanctions are in the right-hand column. Violations are recorded and affect the bonus portion (Motivation Policy).

items.what: Headcount: how many people reported to the site (by crew)
items.to: Telegram chat with Head of CS
items.sanction: A day without a report = a day without confirmed attendance; the day's volumes are counted only after an explanation

items.what: Photos of 3-5 key zones of the site
items.to: Telegram chat with Head of CS
items.sanction: The day's works are unconfirmed without photos until photo documentation is provided

items.what: Summary: progress, problems, needs
items.to: Telegram chat with Head of CS
items.sanction: A problem not stated in the summary is not accepted as a reason for a schedule slip

items.what: Works execution logbook
items.to: on site; Technical Supervision and PTD - upon request
items.sanction: Works without a logbook entry are not confirmed by acceptance certificates

items.what: Machinery timesheet - separately for each unit
items.sanction: Engine hours and fuel are not written off without a timesheet; unexplained downtime is charged to the mechanic

sections.note: Daily photos and summaries go to the Telegram chat (we do not load photos into Worksection). The chat with the Head of CS is the official channel for daily reporting.

items.what: Schedule plan-vs-actual: on schedule - mark "On track"; behind schedule - written explanation of causes and a catch-up plan (free form)
items.sanction: A week without a status update - the week's works are not accepted for closeout; the matter is escalated to a meeting requiring personal attendance

items.what: Weekly photo report: every work item of the week photographed with date and zone reference
items.sanction: Works without a photo report are not accepted for closeout

items.what: Weekly machinery timesheets signed by the Site Manager
items.sanction: Machinery time and fuel are not written off until timesheets are submitted

items.what: Delivery notes + certificates for the week's materials
items.sanction: Materials without documents are not applied to works under acceptance certificates; Concealed Works Acceptance Certificates are not closed

items.what: Report on schedule execution across the portfolio
items.sanction: Escalation under the "Overdue Escalation" section

items.what: Risk register update
items.sanction: A risk not in the register is not accepted as justification for a failure

sections.note: A week on schedule = only the "On track" mark. Explanations are written only when behind schedule.

items.what: Work plan for the next month + schedule + material requirements with deadlines
items.sanction: No plan - the month is not financed, materials are not ordered

items.what: Plan review: reconciliation with the project, cost estimate, and cumulative register; ordering materials
items.sanction: Supply failure is the responsibility of PTD

items.what: Reporting package: certificate (2 signatures) + timesheets + as-built documentation + delivery notes and certificates
items.sanction: If one document or signature is missing, the package is not accepted and payment is not considered

items.what: Technical Verification Note: reconciliation of works, materials, and machinery against the plan and norms
items.sanction: Without the Technical Verification Note, the month's payment is not confirmed

items.what: Budget variance report: line item / plan / actual / reason
items.sanction: An unexplained variance blocks payments under that line item

items.what: Cumulative Works Register update
items.sanction: Protection against double closeouts is the responsibility of PTD

sections.note: Payment chain: package (by the 5th) → PTD review (by the 10th) → Technical Verification Note → approval by Head of CS → payment within the Policy's limits.

items.what: Laboratory test report (concrete at 3/7/28 days, soil, mortar)
items.to: Technical Supervision, Head of CS; copy - PTD
items.sanction: Concealed Works Acceptance Certificates and structure acceptance are not closed without the report

items.what: Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate + photos + original certificates
items.term: before the works are closed out
items.sanction: Works closed without authorization; may be reopened at the contractor's expense

items.what: Change Request (unforeseen works, change in budget / timeline / project)
items.sanction: Works without a Change Request are unauthorized and not paid

items.what: Technical Supervision Directive / remark
Remark resolution status
items.term: per the deadline stated in the Directive
items.sanction: Escalation; repeat violation - memo (Г9)

items.what: Machinery relocation certificate
items.sanction: Logistics and relocation time are not written off

items.what: Memo (violation escalation)
Meeting minutes: decisions, assignments, deadlines
items.sanction: Decisions without minutes are considered not adopted

outro: General rule: a report not submitted on time is considered not submitted. Escalation applies automatically (the "Overdue Escalation" section of the Policy), and the violation is recorded and affects the bonus portion.
